newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia's Ten yr net profit rises 49 pct.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia's Ten yr net profit rises 49 pct.

text.p: Australian television network The Ten Group Ltd said on Thursday it posted a net profit before tax of A$151.1 million in the year to June 30, 1996, up 49 percent on the A$101.4 million posted in 1994/95.
Izzy Asper's CanWest Global Communiciations CWW.TO has a 57 percent economic interest in Ten.
Net profit before tax and before an abnormal gain of A$20.9 million rose 28.4 percent to A$130.2 million.
The abnormal gain was linked to the sale of Ten's 50 percent interest in Capital Television Group Ltd at the same time as the purchase of the Ten stations in Adelaide and Perth.
Earnings before interest and tax rose 29.2 percent to A$139.2 million.
Advertising sales rose 15.4 percent, including eight months of results from the Adelaide and Perth stations.
